Motor_Cooling_Fin.description: Circumferential cooling fins shedding stator heat to engine room air.

Impeller_.description: Rotating vaned wheel imparting centrifugal velocity to seawater.

Suction_Port.label: 06 · Axial Suction Nozzle

Suction_Flange.description: Bolted flange connection to suction piping.

Discharge_Flange.label: 06 · DIN PN16 Discharge Flange
Discharge_Flange.description: Discharge flange feeding the main cooling water header.

Shaft_Seal.label: 07 · Cartridge Mechanical Shaft Seal
Shaft_Seal.description: Silicon-carbide mechanical seal stopping leakage along the shaft.
